info.title: Proto MDK v2
info.description: REST API for managing and monitoring Bitcoin mining hardware.

tags.name: Alerts
tags.description: Alert management, acknowledgement, and real-time streaming.

tags.name: Auth
tags.description: Authentication, session management, and password operations.

tags.name: Diagnostics
tags.description: Read-only database schema and query diagnostics.

tags.name: Feed Mapping
tags.description: CT1 power-feed mapping discovery, planning, run status, and run events.

tags.name: Run-In
tags.description: Factory run-in for individual hashboards and PSU modules.

tags.name: Mining
tags.description: Mining operations, target power, tuning, and start/stop controls.

tags.name: Firmware
tags.description: Hashboard firmware artifact discovery and update deployment.

tags.name: Hashboards
tags.description: Hashboard inventory, health snapshots, and container layout.

tags.name: Pools
tags.description: Mining pool configuration, weighted work sharing, priority fallback, and connection testing.

tags.name: Power
tags.description: Device, hashboard, power-feed, and container plant-control data.

tags.name: System
tags.description: System info, hardware details, firmware, networking, SSH, cooling, and device management.

tags.name: Telemetry
tags.description: Real-time health streaming for hashboards, ASICs, containers, and device metrics.

tags.name: Manufacturing
tags.description: Operator-only hashboard adoption and firmware self-tests.

tags.name: Operational policy
tags.description: Allowlisted live Frigate guardrail and recovery policy.

get.summary: ListAlerts returns alerts with optional filtering and pagination.
StreamAlerts streams new alerts as they fire.

post.summary: AcknowledgeAlert marks an alert as acknowledged.
Login authenticates a user and returns a session token.

Logout invalidates the caller's active session. The REST binding
intentionally accepts an empty body and uses the Authorization bearer
token, preserving existing callers.

parameters.name: token
parameters.description:
token optionally identifies the session for native gRPC callers. An empty
value uses bearer authentication metadata. The REST binding does not map
this field into a request body.

post.summary:
SetPassword sets the initial password during onboarding.
The server MUST reject calls once a password has already been set.

put.summary: ChangePassword updates the password for an authenticated user.

post.summary: RefreshToken exchanges a valid token for a new one.

get.summary:
GetAuthStatus returns the local authentication-onboarding posture. A
client may call it before login to choose initial SetPassword or Login.
GetContainerMap returns the full physical layout of a CT1 container.

DescribeReadOnlyDatabase lists the database objects available to the
dedicated diagnostics reader role.

post.summary:
QueryReadOnlySQL runs exactly one bounded SELECT statement through the
dedicated diagnostics reader role.

get.summary: GetFeedMappingReport returns the currently stored feed mapping report.

parameters.name: changeLimit
parameters.description: Maximum recent changes to include. The server defaults to 50 and caps at 200.

get.summary: GetActiveFeedMappingRun returns the active feed mapping run, if one is running.

post.summary: StartFeedMappingRun starts a feed mapping run.

get.summary: GetFeedMappingRun returns one feed mapping run snapshot.
ListFeedMappingRunEvents returns buffered events for a feed mapping run.

post.summary: CancelFeedMappingRun cancels an active feed mapping run and restores feeds when configured.

get.summary: GetActiveSoftFeedMappingRun returns the active soft mapping run, if one is running.
GetSoftFeedMappingReport returns the most recent soft mapping run, if one exists.

post.summary: StartSoftFeedMappingRun verifies board-to-feed mappings by perturbing one mining board at a time.

get.summary: GetSoftFeedMappingRun returns one soft mapping run snapshot.

post.summary: ApplySoftFeedMappingRun applies high-confidence changed/added mappings from a completed soft run.
CancelSoftFeedMappingRun cancels an active soft mapping run and restores the current board when possible.
PlanFeedMappingRun validates and previews a feed mapping run.

get.summary: GetFirmwarePolicy returns the container's desired exact firmware target.

put.summary: SetFirmwarePolicy revision-fences a hot policy replacement or disable.

get.summary: ListFirmwarePolicyBoards returns retained compliance and retry state.

post.summary: RetryFirmwarePolicyBoards resets terminal policy failures for a scope.

get.summary: ListFirmwareUpdates lists active and completed update jobs, newest first.

parameters.name: localOnly
parameters.description:
local_only is used by HA peers to avoid recursive fanout when aggregating
cluster update lists. Ordinary clients leave it false.

post.summary: StartFirmwareUpdate deploys an uploaded firmware artifact to the selected boards.

get.summary: GetFirmwareUpdate returns the current state of one update job.

parameters.name: serverId
parameters.description:
server_id optionally selects which Frigate node owns task_id. Empty means
the connected node, preserving pre-cluster behavior.

post.summary: CancelFirmwareUpdate requests cancellation of an active update job.

parameters.name: serverId
parameters.description:
server_id optionally selects which Frigate node owns task_id. Empty means
the connected node, preserving pre-cluster behavior.

get.summary: ListHashboards returns currently visible hashboards with their latest health snapshots.

post.summary:
SetIdentifyLED records the desired identification LED state for a board or
module. The HA node that owns each board applies the command to firmware.

get.summary:
GetHashboard returns one hashboard selected by CT1 MAC address or R2 serial
number.

parameters.name: identifier
parameters.description: identifier accepts a CT1 MAC address or R2 serial number.

get.summary:
GetHashboardASICMetadata reads decoded ASIC eFuse metadata from a connected
board selected by CT1 MAC address or R2 serial number. Firmware makes this
data available only after ASIC enumeration, so
the board must have reached the mining state. An implementation may cache
a successful read for the lifetime of that board connection.

parameters.name: identifier
parameters.description: identifier accepts a CT1 MAC address or R2 serial number.

get.summary:
GetHashboardASICs returns ASIC-level health data for one hashboard selected
by CT1 MAC address or R2 serial number.

parameters.name: identifier
parameters.description: identifier accepts a CT1 MAC address or R2 serial number.

get.summary:
GetHashboardEvents returns recent history for one hashboard selected by CT1
MAC address or R2 serial number.

parameters.name: identifier
parameters.description: identifier accepts a CT1 MAC address or R2 serial number.

post.summary: StartHashboardRunIn starts a factory run-in task for one hashboard.

parameters.name: taskId
parameters.description: task_id is an optional caller-generated idempotency key for this task.

get.summary: ListIsolation returns the current set of isolated hashboards.

post.summary:
SetIsolation marks or clears isolation for an explicit set of hashboards.
Isolated boards are excluded from cluster start/stop and from the
mining-intent reconciler. On clear, the server re-aligns the boards to the
current cluster mining intent.

get.summary:
ListModuleVoltageSettings returns durable fixed/AUTO settings and the
firmware-supported voltage range for every known module ID.

delete.summary:
ClearModuleFixedVoltage persists and applies automatic voltage tuning for
one module.

put.summary: SetModuleFixedVoltage persists and applies one module-wide fixed voltage.

post.summary:
SetPowerTargetScoped sets a manual per-board power target on an explicit set
of ISOLATED hashboards. Isolation is required so the fleet power reconciler
does not fight the manual target; it is validated per board.

ClearPowerTargetScoped removes manual per-board power targets from an
explicit set of isolated hashboards, restoring automatic tuning.

StartMiningScoped begins mining for an explicit set of hashboards. Isolated
boards are eligible (this is how operators drive them). Cluster intent is
not changed.

StopMiningScoped halts mining for an explicit set of hashboards. Cluster
intent is not changed.
StartMining begins mining operations.

get.summary: GetMiningStatus returns aggregate mining status across all hashboards.

post.summary: StopMining halts mining operations.

get.summary: GetTargetPower returns the current target power setting.

put.summary: SetTargetPower sets the target power for mining operations.

get.summary: GetTuning returns the active product-specific tuning algorithm.

put.summary: SetTuning configures the exact product-specific tuning algorithm.

post.summary: EnableVoltageTuning enables automatic PSU voltage tuning on local hashboards.

SetFixedVoltage disables automatic PSU voltage tuning and requests one
fleet-wide fixed voltage from 26,000 through 30,000 millivolts inclusive.
StartModuleRunIn starts one synchronized tuning sweep across the connected hashboards in a PSU module.

parameters.name: taskId
parameters.description: task_id is an optional caller-generated idempotency key for this task.

get.summary: ListPools returns all configured mining pools ordered by priority.

post.summary: CreatePool adds a new pool configuration.

get.summary:
GetPoolDiagnostics returns per-configured-enabled-pool runtime connection
diagnostics reflecting this node's live pool connections. The manager tracks
only enabled pools (SetPools filters to enabled), so disabled pools are not
included.
GetPool returns a single pool by ID.

post.summary: TestPoolConnection tests connectivity to a configured pool.

put.summary: UpdatePool updates an existing pool configuration.

post.summary: MuteContainerAlarm pulses the container controller's alarm mute. CT1 only.
ResetContainerAlarm pulses the container controller's alarm reset. CT1 only.

get.summary:
GetContainerControls returns the tank/container plant controls (boolean
switches) and analog setpoints exposed by the container backend, with their
current states where the backend can read them back. Backends without
control support report supported=false with empty lists. CT1 only.

post.summary:
SetContainerControl switches one boolean tank/container control
(tank_led_light, coolant_pump, dry_cooler, dry_cooler_auto,
air_conditioner_1, or air_conditioner_2) and echoes the state written.
The PLC is authoritative for plant protection and command acceptance.
CT1 only.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: name is the control identifier; bound from the path.

post.summary:
RunDryCoolerFanReverse applies a retained 3-10 whole-minute duration,
starts the PLC-owned procedure, and returns after terminal completion.
The operation never exposes or writes a manual stop command. CT1 only.

SetMainCircuitBreakerState requests an idempotent closed/open target and
returns the controller's authoritative closed-state readback. CT1 only.

SetContainerSetpoint writes one analog tank/container setpoint and echoes
the applied value. Temperature setpoints are Celsius. Frigate validates
only the finite float32 wire representation; the PLC owns operational
limits and final command acceptance. CT1 only.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: name is the setpoint identifier; bound from the path.

get.summary: GetDevicePower returns aggregate device power consumption.
ListPowerFeeds returns power-feed state and optional electrical telemetry.

post.summary:
ClearPowerFeedOverride removes the process-local operator marker from one
power feed without changing its backend target or physical state. CT1 only.

parameters.name: powerFeedId
parameters.description:
power_feed_id is the container power-feed identifier, e.g.
"pdu-1-outlet-03"; bound from the path.

post.summary: SetPowerFeedState enables or disables one container power feed.

CyclePowerFeed disables one enabled container power feed, holds it off for
30 seconds, and restores it as one durable Frigate-owned operation. The
restore survives disconnects, restart, and HA handoff. CT1 only.

parameters.name: powerFeedId
parameters.description: power_feed_id is the enabled, non-faulted container power-feed identifier.

get.summary: ListHashboardPower returns per-hashboard power consumption.

GetActivePowerRecoveryCycle returns the singleton durable outlet restore
obligation, whether initiated by an operator or automatic recovery.
ListHashboardRunInTasks lists active and completed run-in tasks.

parameters.name: localOnly
parameters.description: local_only prevents peer fanout loops on peer-internal reads.

get.summary: GetHashboardRunInStatus returns the current status for a run-in task.

parameters.name: serverId
parameters.description: Blank preserves the legacy local-only lookup during rolling deployment.

post.summary: CancelHashboardRunIn requests cancellation for a run-in task.

parameters.name: serverId
parameters.description: Blank preserves the legacy local-only lookup during rolling deployment.

get.summary: ListAuditEvents returns recent audit-log entries, newest first.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description:
Maximum entries to return; 0 applies the server default (200), capped
at 1000.

parameters.name: action
parameters.description: Exact-match filters; empty means no filter.

get.summary: GetCoolingConfig returns the cooling configuration.

post.summary: ApplyFirmwareUpdate applies a firmware update.

get.summary: CheckFirmwareUpdate checks for available firmware updates.
GetHardwareInfo returns hardware details.
GetSystemInfo returns static system information.

post.summary: LocateDevice activates the device locator LED.

get.summary: GetLogs returns a stream of system log entries.
GetNetworkConfig returns the network configuration.
ListPowerSupplies returns information about installed PSUs.

post.summary: UpdatePSUFirmware initiates a firmware update on a PSU.
Reboot reboots the device.

get.summary: GetSSHConfig returns the SSH configuration.
GetSystemStatus returns current system status.
ListTags returns the system's tag set.

put.summary: SetTags replaces the system's tag set.

get.summary: GetUnlockStatus returns the device unlock status.

ListUnitTags returns operator tags for modules, hashboards, and container
power feeds.

put.summary:
SetUnitTag upserts an operator tag for a module (keyed by module ID), a
hashboard (keyed by MAC address), or a container power feed (keyed by
backend feed ID). An empty tag deletes the entry.

get.summary: GetContainerHealth returns a point-in-time plant and power-feed snapshot.

ListContainerPlantAlarmEpisodes reconstructs active and cleared PLC alarm
intervals from the durable transition journal.

ListContainerPlantEvents returns durable control, setpoint, alarm, fault,
power-feed, and observed-state transitions.
StreamContainerHealth streams container plant and power-feed telemetry.
StreamDeviceMetrics streams aggregate device-level metrics.
StreamHashboardHealth streams hashboard health snapshots at ~1Hz.

parameters.name: identifier
parameters.description: identifier accepts a CT1 MAC address or R2 serial number.

get.summary: StreamASICHealth streams per-ASIC health data for a single hashboard.

parameters.name: identifier
parameters.description: identifier accepts a CT1 MAC address or R2 serial number.

get.summary:
GetHashboardLifetime returns the cumulative runtime the service has
observed for one hashboard. It is preserved independently of retained raw
health samples and excludes unobserved telemetry gaps.

QueryShareQualityHistory returns indefinitely retained share-quality
summaries without scanning raw nonces and work IDs.
GetShareQuality returns share acceptance, rejection, and accepted-hashrate statistics over a window.

parameters.name: identifier
parameters.description:
identifier is an optional CT1 MAC address or R2 serial number that
restricts only the by_board breakdown. It does not filter by
pool and is not a pool name.

get.summary:
QueryTimeSeries queries historical time series data, returning bucketed
aggregates (average, minimum, maximum, and sample count) over the requested
metric, time range, and bucket size.

parameters.name: metric
parameters.description:
- TIME_SERIES_METRIC_PLANT_INLET_TEMPERATURE: Plant metrics are container-scoped and ignore the identifier field.
 - TIME_SERIES_METRIC_PLANT_PHASE_POWER: Component metrics require identifier to select a phase, distribution
unit, fan, or power feed.
 - TIME_SERIES_METRIC_TEMPERATURE_SENSOR: Sensor-specific board or PSU temperature history. Requests must include a
TemperatureSeriesSelector; the legacy TEMPERATURE metric remains the
aggregate across every board sensor.

parameters.name: identifier
parameters.description:
identifier is a CT1 MAC address or R2 serial number for board metrics. It
is the phase, distribution-unit, fan, or power-feed ID for component plant
metrics.

shareWeight.description:
share_weight enables weighted mining for this pool. It is a relative,
positive weight; when absent the pool remains a priority failover target.

pool.description:
Pool represents a mining pool configuration.
The password field is write-only and never included in responses.

password.description:
password is the pool authentication password (write-only, never returned in
responses). An EMPTY password preserves the stored credential; there is
currently no way to clear a stored password via this API.

updateMask.description:
update_mask selects which Pool fields to apply; unselected fields are
backfilled from the stored record so a partial write (for example an
enabled-only toggle) can never erase configuration. Valid paths: name,
url, username, priority, enabled, share_weight (plus id, a no-op);
unknown paths are refused. A masked share_weight is
presence-authoritative: an absent value clears the stored weight. A pool
name can never be cleared; an empty masked name preserves the stored one.

Compatibility: an EMPTY mask keeps the legacy contract — all Pool fields
are applied, and an absent share_weight preserves the stored weight. The
historical single-path {"share_weight"} mask likewise applies the full
record while treating share_weight absence as a clear, because deployed
TUI clients send it that way with every update.

PowerServiceClearPowerFeedOverrideBody.description:
ClearPowerFeedOverrideRequest clears one power feed's process-local operator
marker.

enabled.description: enabled selects the target state: true starts/enables, false stops/disables.

force.description:
Deprecated compatibility bit for Frigate versions that enforced
application-side plant safety policy. Current servers ignore it.

PowerServiceSetContainerControlBody.description: SetContainerControlRequest switches one boolean container control.

value.description:
value must be representable as a finite float32 PLC wire value. The PLC
owns operational limits and final command acceptance.

force.description:
Deprecated compatibility bit for Frigate versions that enforced
application-side plant safety policy. Current servers ignore it.

PowerServiceSetContainerSetpointBody.description: SetContainerSetpointRequest writes one analog container setpoint.

force.description:
Deprecated compatibility bit for Frigate versions that enforced
application-side plant safety policy. Current servers ignore it.

mdkV2Tag.description: Tag represents a key-value metadata tag.

@type.description:
A URL/resource name that uniquely identifies the type of the serialized
protocol buffer message. This string must contain at least
one "/" character. The last segment of the URL's path must represent
the fully qualified name of the type (as in
`path/google.protobuf.Duration`). The name should be in a canonical form
(e.g., leading "." is not accepted).

In practice, teams usually precompile into the binary all types that they
expect it to use in the context of Any. However, for URLs which use the
scheme `http`, `https`, or no scheme, one can optionally set up a type
server that maps type URLs to message definitions as follows:

* If no scheme is provided, `https` is assumed.
* An HTTP GET on the URL must yield a [google.protobuf.Type][]
  value in binary format, or produce an error.
* Applications are allowed to cache lookup results based on the
  URL, or have them precompiled into a binary to avoid any
  lookup. Therefore, binary compatibility needs to be preserved
  on changes to types. (Use versioned type names to manage
  breaking changes.)

Note: this functionality is not currently available in the official
protobuf release, and it is not used for type URLs beginning with
type.googleapis.com. As of May 2023, there are no widely used type server
implementations and no plans to implement one.

Schemes other than `http`, `https` (or the empty scheme) might be
used with implementation specific semantics.

code.description:
The status code, which should be an enum value of
[google.rpc.Code][google.rpc.Code].

message.description:
A developer-facing error message, which should be in English. Any
user-facing error message should be localized and sent in the
[google.rpc.Status.details][google.rpc.Status.details] field, or localized
by the client.

details.description:
A list of messages that carry the error details.  There is a common set of
message types for APIs to use.

rpcStatus.description:
The `Status` type defines a logical error model that is suitable for
different programming environments, including REST APIs and RPC APIs. It is
used by [gRPC](https://github.com/grpc). Each `Status` message contains
three pieces of data: error code, error message, and error details.

You can find out more about this error model and how to work with it in the
[API Design Guide](https://cloud.google.com/apis/design/errors).

index.description: index is the zero-based physical ASIC position on the hashboard.

voltageMv.description: voltage_mv is the ASIC voltage in millivolts.

temperatureDc.description: temperature_dc is the ASIC temperature in decicelsius (e.g. 725 = 72.5 C).

frequencyMhz.description: frequency_mhz is the ASIC clock frequency in megahertz.

passRateBp.description: pass_rate_bp is the nonce pass rate in basis points (e.g. 9950 = 99.50%).

hashrateGhs10.description: hashrate_ghs10 is the hashrate in GH/s * 10 (e.g. 125 = 12.5 GH/s).

thermalQuarantined.description:
ThermalQuarantined is present when firmware supplied a valid thermal-
throttle snapshot covering this ASIC. Absence means not reported.

compactIndex.description:
compact_index is the original zero-based CT1 firmware identity. It is
absent when the producer cannot map this sample to a physical position.

v2ASIC.description: ASIC represents per-ASIC health data on a hashboard.

v2ASICLayoutEntry.description: ASICLayoutEntry maps an ASIC index to its physical hashboard position.

valid.description: valid is true when firmware successfully decoded this ASIC's eFuse data.

grwvpl.description: grwvpl is the ASIC manufacturer part number.

v2ASICMetadata.description:
ASICMetadata is decoded, immutable eFuse identity and binning data for one
ASIC. index uses the same zero-based physical index as ASIC and
HashboardASICLayout.

resourceId.description:
resource_id is the source's stable ID for non-hashboard sources. R2
hashboards use serial instead.

slot.description: slot is one-based when the source has a physical chassis slot.

serial.description: serial is the stable R2 hashboard identity and is empty for other sources.

v2AlertSourceKind.description: AlertSourceKind identifies the typed resource class that emitted an alert.

actor.description: Actor is the client-supplied identity ("user@host") or subsystem name.

node.description: Node is the server ID of the node that performed the action.

action.description: Action is a dotted verb, e.g. "mining.stop".

detailsJson.description: Structured JSON payload; empty when the action recorded no details.

v2AuditEvent.description: AuditEvent is one recorded operator- or system-initiated action.

v2AuthStatus.description:
AuthStatus contains local authentication posture rather than operational
system health. Presence distinguishes an authoritative false value from an
implementation that cannot report the field.

applied.description: True if the operation reached this board.

v2BoardResult.description: BoardResult reports the per-board outcome of a scoped operation.

v2BoardScope.description:
BoardScope selects hashboards. identifiers are MAC addresses or serials; modules
selects whole container modules by tank/module. The selections union (OR); at
least one is required.

index.description: index is the zero-based firmware sensor index.

temperature.description: temperature is the board temperature in degrees Celsius.

v2BoardTemperatureSensor.description: BoardTemperatureSensor is one board-level temperature sample with its physical identity.

v2BoardTemperatureSensorLocation.description: BoardTemperatureSensorLocation identifies where a board temperature sensor is mounted.

v2BucketSize.description: BucketSize represents the aggregation interval for time series queries.

v2CheckFirmwareUpdateResponse.description: CheckFirmwareUpdateResponse contains firmware update availability details.

v2ClearPowerFeedOverrideResponse.description:
ClearPowerFeedOverrideResponse returns the unchanged power-feed state with
its operator marker cleared.

name.description:
name is the backend control identifier, e.g. "coolant_pump" or
"tank_led_light".

enabled.description:
enabled is the control's current (or just-written) state. Only meaningful
when state_known is true.

stateKnown.description:
state_known is true when enabled reflects a state read back from the
controller rather than an unknown default.

coolingCritical.description:
Deprecated application-side safety classification. Current servers always
return false because the PLC owns plant safety interlocks.

v2ContainerControl.description: ContainerControl is one boolean tank/container plant control.

v2ContainerMap.description: ContainerMap represents the full physical layout of a CT1 container.

v2ContainerPlantEvent.description: ContainerPlantEvent is one durable discrete state transition.

name.description:
name is the backend setting identifier, e.g. "coolant_pump_speed_hz" or
"dry_cooler_auto_temp_c".

value.description: value is the current (or just-applied) setpoint value.

min.description:
Documented PLC range metadata for operator display. Frigate does not use
these values as an application-side write limit.

boundsKnown.description:
Legacy presence marker. True means min and max contain documented range
metadata; it does not imply application-side enforcement.

v2ContainerSetpoint.description: ContainerSetpoint is one writable analog tank/container setting.

v2ControlBoardInfo.description: ControlBoardInfo contains stable control-board hardware identity.

fanId.description:
fan_id is a required, nonzero device-local identity. It is unique within
HardwareInfo.cooling_fans and joins this inventory entry to
CoolingFanStatus.fan_id.

slot.description: slot is one-based when the platform reports a physical fan position.

v2CoolingFanInfo.description: CoolingFanInfo contains one installed fan's immutable operating range.

fanId.description:
fan_id is a required, nonzero device-local identity. It is unique within
GetCoolingConfigResponse.fans and must match a CoolingFanInfo.fan_id
returned by GetHardwareInfo.

slot.description: slot is one-based when the platform reports a physical fan position.

v2CoolingFanStatus.description: CoolingFanStatus contains one fan's observed operating state.

password.description: password is the pool authentication password (write-only, never returned in responses).

v2DiagnosticsDatabaseRouting.description:
DiagnosticsDatabaseRouting identifies whether a relation can be read from a
physical standby without losing non-WAL-replicated data.

recoveryCauses.description: Legacy numeric values retained for mixed-version Flotilla deployments.

recoveryScope.description: Recovery scope is intentionally fixed and reported for operator clarity.

v2FanMode.description:
FanMode represents the fan control strategy.

 - FAN_MODE_OFF: OFF explicitly disables fans when platform cooling policy permits it.

v2FeedMappingChange.description: FeedMappingChange is one durable transition in the current feed map.

v2FeedMappingChangeType.description: FeedMappingChangeType classifies a durable current-map transition.

v2FeedMappingDetectedBoard.description: FeedMappingDetectedBoard identifies a board detected during feed mapping.

v2FeedMappingFeedResult.description: FeedMappingFeedResult contains mapping results for one feed.

v2FeedMappingFeedStatus.description: FeedMappingFeedStatus is the lifecycle state for one feed in a run.

v2FeedMappingRun.description: FeedMappingRun is a snapshot of a feed mapping run.

feedIds.description: Feed IDs to map. Empty means all configured power feeds for the active backend.

feedTimeout.description: Maximum time to wait for boards after enabling one feed.

isolationQuiet.description: Quiet window after disabling all feeds before mapping starts.

offlineQuiet.description: Quiet window used to confirm mapped boards went offline after a feed is disabled.

expectedBoardsPerFeed.description: Optional early-completion count for each feed.

onlineSettle.description: Grace period after the expected boards appear before accepting a feed.

restoreAllOn.description: Restore all isolation feeds to ON when the run completes.

dryRun.description: Validate and return a plan without writing hardware state.

v2FeedMappingRunConfig.description: FeedMappingRunConfig configures feed mapping run behavior.

v2FeedMappingRunEvent.description: FeedMappingRunEvent is an event emitted during feed mapping runs.

v2FeedMappingRunStatus.description: FeedMappingRunStatus is the lifecycle state of a feed mapping run.

prNumber.description:
Pull-request fields (source = PR). artifact_id and artifact_name are
shared with BRANCH refs.

uploadId.description: upload_id is the server-assigned content digest for an uploaded bundle.

v2FirmwareArtifactRef.description: FirmwareArtifactRef identifies one deployable firmware artifact.

v2FirmwareArtifactSource.description:
FirmwareArtifactSource identifies where a firmware artifact comes from.

 - FIRMWARE_ARTIFACT_SOURCE_UPLOAD: UPLOAD identifies content delivered by an operator client and cached by
its content digest. RELEASE, PR, and BRANCH remain for source
attribution/history.
 - FIRMWARE_ARTIFACT_SOURCE_BRANCH: BRANCH identifies a workflow artifact built by a push to a branch
(typically tip of main).

compatibleHardwareRevisions.description:
compatible_hardware_revisions lists the board hardware revisions this
image can flash, resolved server-side from hardware_revision with the
same hbmeta family/metadata gates used by deployment preflight. Empty
means the server did not resolve compatibility (older server or unknown
revision string), not universal compatibility.

hash.description: hash is the exact embedded firmware identity reported after boot.

sha256.description: sha256 is the digest of the complete signed image file.

v2FirmwareImage.description:
FirmwareImage is the decoded metadata of one firmware .bin inside an
artifact.

v2FirmwareTargetSelector.description: FirmwareTargetSelector selects exactly one R2 board by its stable serial.

v2FirmwareTargetStatus.description: FirmwareTargetStatus is the lifecycle state of one board within a job.

serverId.description:
server_id is the CT1 Frigate node that owns this update job. It is empty
for R2, whose singleton device service already identifies the owner.

v2FirmwareUpdate.description: FirmwareUpdate is one firmware update job.

force.description: force flashes even when the image version is not newer.

skipStopMining.description:
skip_stop_mining refuses boards that are not already idle instead of
stopping them.

skipRestoreMining.description: skip_restore_mining leaves boards idle after a successful flash.

maxParallel.description: max_parallel bounds concurrent flashes; 0 uses the server default.

dryRun.description: dry_run stops after preflight and reports what would happen.

build.description:
build restricts image selection to one build type (e.g. "prod", "dev",
"mfgtest") when an artifact carries several builds per hardware family.
Empty requires the artifact to be unambiguous.

v2FirmwareUpdateOptions.description:
FirmwareUpdateOptions tune one update job. Proto3 zero values give the safe
defaults: stop mining before flashing and restore it afterwards.

v2FirmwareUpdateStatus.description: FirmwareUpdateStatus is the lifecycle state of an update job.

macAddress.description: mac_address is the CT1 board identity and must be empty for R2.

serial.description:
serial is the stable R2 board identity. CT1 boards may also report it but
retain mac_address as their identity.

phase.description: phase details the DFU stage while flashing (preparing/writing/activating).

reason.description: reason is a stable failure classifier (e.g. dfu_write_failed).

slot.description: slot is the optional one-based R2 chassis observation.

v2FrequencyRange.description: FrequencyRange defines requested ASIC PLL frequency sweep points in MHz.

supported.description:
supported is false when the configured container backend has no plant
controls (for example, ANEN); controls and setpoints are then empty.

alarmResetSupported.description:
Alarm commands are separate capabilities because some controllers expose
persistent plant controls without alarm reset or mute endpoints. Optional
presence lets newer clients preserve alarm actions against older servers
that predate these capability fields.

mainCircuitBreakerSupported.description:
main_circuit_breaker_supported advertises the dedicated open/close
command. main_circuit_breaker_closed is authoritative PLC readback.

v2GetContainerControlsResponse.description: GetContainerControlsResponse lists the container plant controls and setpoints.

v2GetContainerHealthResponse.description: GetContainerHealthResponse contains a point-in-time container health snapshot.

v2GetDevicePowerResponse.description: GetDevicePowerResponse contains aggregate device power consumption.

changesTruncated.description: True when more durable changes exist than were returned.

changesUnavailable.description: True when the current report succeeded but durable change history could not be read.

macAddress.description: mac_address is the legacy CT1 identity and is empty for R2.

effectiveWindow.description:
effective_window is the actual [start, end) window the server used after
applying the default span and clamping, so clients know the real span
covered by the returned events.

serial.description: serial is the stable R2 identity.

slot.description: slot is the optional one-based R2 chassis slot.

macAddress.description: mac_address is the legacy CT1 identity and is empty for R2.

miningTimeMs.description:
mining_time_ms is the legacy state-based counter retained for older
clients. It can include READY or MINING intervals with zero hashrate.

serial.description: serial is the stable R2 identity.

slot.description: slot is the current optional one-based R2 chassis slot.

observedUptime.description:
observed_uptime contains only complete-age windows with substantiated
observation time. Telemetry gaps longer than 90 seconds are excluded from
both powered and observed time.

hashingTimeMs.description:
hashing_time_ms is the corrected time the board produced positive finite
hashrate in an operational READY or MINING state. Presence distinguishes
it from the legacy counter returned by older servers. It includes run-in
and internal work that does not use an external pool.

hashingObservedSince.description: hashing_observed_since marks the corrected counter epoch.

bestEffortHashingTimeMs.description:
best_effort_hashing_time_ms is the portion of hashing_time_ms inferred by
an explicit operator repair from pre-cutover rows without HA writer
identity. The remainder is owner-authoritative.

v2GetHashboardLifetimeResponse.description:
GetHashboardLifetimeResponse contains service-observed lifetime runtime.
A nil first_observed_at means the selected board has not yet supplied a
persisted health sample.

v2GetLogsResponse.description: GetLogsResponse contains a single log entry from the stream.

activePoolId.description:
active_pool_id is the highest-priority active pool for compatibility;
inspect each pool's is_active field when weighted_mode is true.

v2GetPoolDiagnosticsResponse.description:
GetPoolDiagnosticsResponse contains per-configured-enabled-pool runtime
connection diagnostics reflecting this node's live pool connections. Only
enabled pools are tracked, so disabled pools are absent.

watts.description: watts is the current applied target.

v2GetTuningResponse.description: GetTuningResponse reports the canonical tuning algorithm currently applied.

v2HARecoveryPhase.description:
HARecoveryPhase identifies the highest-priority recovery work still in
progress. Values are ordered by the runtime sequence, not by severity.

v2HARecoveryState.description:
HARecoveryState describes whether this Frigate process has returned to a
trustworthy steady state after a Patroni primary transition.

v2HARecoveryStatus.description:
HARecoveryStatus is bounded, machine-readable progress for one post-Patroni
recovery episode. It is process-local status backed by shared assignment
authority; it is not a durable workflow record.

v2HARole.description: HARole identifies this server's role in a high-availability cluster.

recordedHashboards.description:
recorded_hashboards contains only static, display-only inventory evidence.
An empty collection means there is no recorded evidence; it does not
establish that the chassis currently contains no hashboards. Consumers
must use HashboardService for current presence.

v2HardwareRev.description:
HardwareRev mirrors the hashboard firmware hardware_revision enum
(lib/hashboard/lib/protobuf/protos/hashboard_cmd.proto) value for value, so
clients can compare it numerically against the advertised
Hashboard.hw_revision string without re-implementing hbmeta's
metadata-revision translation.

macAddress.description:
mac_address is the legacy CT1 board identity. It is empty for R2 and must
never contain a synthesized address.

serial.description:
serial is the stable physical identity for R2 and must be populated. CT1
retains its existing MAC identity and may also report a serial.

moduleId.description:
Latest module ID as 16-character lowercase hex. Live advertisements take
precedence, with the shared last-known identity used across restart/HA.

isolated.description:
isolated is true when this board is excluded from cluster start/stop and the
mining-intent reconciler. Set via MiningService.SetIsolation. Reflects only
the serving node's process-local isolation set; it is always false for
boards with source HASHBOARD_SOURCE_REMOTE even if the owning node has
isolated them.

firmwareVersion.description: Semantic hashboard firmware version advertised over L2, for example "1.2.3".

psuType.description:
Power supply type reported by firmware health telemetry, for example
"BOCO" or "WELLTIP". Populated only for boards with a live local
connection; empty when the type has not been reported.

firmwareGitHash.description:
Abbreviated commit hash extracted from the active firmware image's Git
describe identifier, for example "1a2b3c4". Populated only for boards
with a live local connection; empty when firmware metadata has not been read.

recovery.description:
recovery is present while bounded automatic READY retries are active or
exhausted for a protected MC3 firmware recovery episode.

powerTargetMinWatts.description:
power_target_min_watts and power_target_max_watts are the latest valid
per-board tuning limits advertised by locally connected firmware.

asicBin.description:
asic_bin is the complete board-level CP-bin summary decoded from ASIC
eFuse GRWVPL values. It is one exact TUI-compatible name (for example
"Z11" or "M04"), a catalogued V8 mixed-bin PCBA recipe label when its
distinct-bin presence signature matches exactly (for example "3A08MX1"),
"Mixed" for other complete valid mixtures, or empty when metadata is
unavailable, incomplete, or invalid. Recipe labels do not verify bin
multiplicity or placement.

psuIdentity.description: psu_identity is durable module-level enrichment keyed by module_id.

v2Hashboard.description: Hashboard represents a mining hashboard with its current state and health.

v2HashboardASICErrorState.description: HashboardASICErrorState contains ASIC-specific detail for an error.

v2HashboardASICLayout.description: HashboardASICLayout describes the physical ASIC layout for a hashboard.

v2HashboardASICThermalThrottleHealth.description:
HashboardASICThermalThrottleHealth is one firmware-reported FMargin
thermal-throttle snapshot. quarantined_asic_ids are compact firmware ASIC
identities and must be joined through ASIC.compact_index before display.

v2HashboardErrorCause.description:
HashboardErrorCause identifies a firmware-reported or Frigate-derived
hashboard error or warning cause.

 - HASHBOARD_ERROR_CAUSE_ASIC_THERMAL_THROTTLING: Frigate derives thermal throttling from asic_thermal_throttle; firmware
does not emit this value in its errors or warnings arrays.

time.description: For aggregated cause events, first-seen time.

stack.description: raw zero-based firmware stack index, when reported.

v2HashboardEvent.description: HashboardEvent is a single entry in a hashboard's event history.

v2HashboardEventType.description: HashboardEventType categorizes an entry in a hashboard event history.

lastShutdownError.description:
Latched reason for the most recent mining shutdown. This is diagnostic
history and must not be counted as an active error.

averageAsicTemperatureC.description:
average_asic_temperature_c is absent when the source cannot distinguish
ASIC temperature from other board sensors.

fmarginMeanMhz.description:
Mean ASIC Fbest headroom in MHz, present only after firmware FMargin has
produced a valid sample for the current controller run.

v2HashboardHealth.description: HashboardHealth contains real-time health metrics for a hashboard.

stack.description: Stack is the raw zero-based firmware stack index for stack-scoped errors.

v2HashboardHealthError.description:
HashboardHealthError is a firmware-reported or Frigate-derived error or
warning.

v2HashboardHistoricalIdentityEvidence.description:
HashboardHistoricalIdentityEvidence is the last valid occupied identity
observed in one physical slot. It can be rendered while the current slot is
UNKNOWN or EMPTY, but it is never current authority. After a board moves, the
same serial_number can appear in more than one slot's history; board-catalog
consumers should retain the newest observed_at.

v2HashboardIdentifyLEDMode.description: HashboardIdentifyLEDMode is the operator-requested identification LED mode.

slot.description: slot is the optional one-based R2 chassis slot.

hashboardPosition.description:
hashboard_position is the resolved one-based board position within a CT1
module. Values 1-3 are displayed as HB1-HB3. It is absent when Frigate
cannot place the board safely.

hashboardPositionSource.description:
hashboard_position_source describes whether the resolved position came
from firmware identity or the deterministic legacy MAC-order fallback.

v2HashboardLocation.description: HashboardLocation describes the physical position of a hashboard.

v2HashboardPerformanceTuningAlgorithm.description:
HashboardPerformanceTuningAlgorithm is the performance tuning algorithm
currently selected by the hashboard firmware. Presence on HashboardHealth
distinguishes a reported NONE value from legacy health telemetry.

v2HashboardPositionSource.description:
HashboardPositionSource identifies the evidence used to place a CT1 board
within its three-board module.

macAddress.description:
mac_address is the legacy CT1 board identity. It is empty for R2 and must
never contain a synthesized address.

watts.description: watts is instantaneous board power in watts.

voltage.description: voltage is board input voltage in volts.

current.description: current is board input current in amperes.

hashrate.description: hashrate is board hashrate in terahashes per second.

serial.description: serial is the stable R2 board identity.

slot.description: slot is the optional one-based R2 chassis slot.

v2HashboardPower.description: HashboardPower contains power consumption data for a single hashboard.

v2HashboardRecovery.description: HashboardRecovery is the shared HA-safe automatic READY retry state.

v2HashboardRunInConfig.description: HashboardRunInConfig configures a single hashboard run-in task.

v2HashboardRunInStatus.description: HashboardRunInStatus is the lifecycle state of a run-in task.

activeVoltageSetpointMillivolts.description:
Requested fixed PSU voltage for the active tuning-sweep point. Zero when
the task is not currently executing a fixed-voltage point.

v2HashboardRunInTask.description: HashboardRunInTask is a status snapshot for a run-in task.

v2HashboardSlotState.description:
HashboardSlotState distinguishes incomplete observations from confirmed
empty and occupied chassis slots.

v2HashboardSource.description: HashboardSource describes where the board state in this response came from.

miningDropoutDuration.description:
mining_dropout_duration is the continuous post-ramp zero-hash or
non-operational window before the run fails. Zero defaults to 30 seconds.

v2HashboardTopology.description:
HashboardTopology describes the bounded R2 chassis topology. The whole
message is omitted for products without a fixed slot topology. capacity is
the nonzero number of physical slots. generation changes whenever capacity,
current slot state, or current serial identity changes; a last_known-only
update does not change generation. complete is true only when slots contains
exactly one EMPTY or OCCUPIED observation for every slot from 1 through
capacity. Each OCCUPIED entry must match exactly one Hashboard in the same
ListHashboardsResponse by serial, and its HashboardLocation.slot must agree.
When complete is false, an unreported slot is UNKNOWN and must never be
inferred to be EMPTY.

lastKnown.description:
last_known is historical evidence only. It is emitted only for UNKNOWN or
EMPTY slots because an OCCUPIED slot already carries current identity.

v2HashboardTopologySlot.description:
HashboardTopologySlot is one one-based chassis slot observation. slot must be
within [1, HashboardTopology.capacity], and a topology must not contain the
same slot more than once. UNSPECIFIED is never valid in an emitted slot.
OCCUPIED requires serial_number; UNKNOWN and EMPTY require it to be empty.

v2HashboardVoltageDomain.description: HashboardVoltageDomain identifies the ASIC voltage domain involved in an error.

v2HashboardVoltageTuningState.description:
HashboardVoltageTuningState is the firmware-reported automatic PSU voltage
tuning state. Presence on HashboardHealth distinguishes a reported DISABLED
state from a board that has not supplied health telemetry yet.

v2HealthStatus.description: HealthStatus represents the overall health of the system.

v2HistorySource.description: HistorySource identifies the retained resolution used for a response bucket.

reason.description:
reason is the operator-entered note recorded when the board was isolated
(e.g. who has claimed the unit and why).

isolatedBy.description: isolated_by is the server that recorded the isolation.

isolatedAt.description: isolated_at is when the isolation was recorded.

desiredWatts.description:
desired_watts, when present, is the scoped manual per-board target recorded
in the shared isolation ledger.

desiredPllAlgorithm.description:
desired_pll_algorithm is the requested PLL algorithm recorded alongside
desired_watts. It is not firmware readback of the effective algorithm.

enforced.description:
enforced reports whether this node is actively enforcing the isolation.
It is false when no current node manages or owns the ledger-isolated board.

snapshotReady.description:
snapshot_ready distinguishes a successful empty controller poll from the
startup window before the container monitor has completed its first poll.
Optional presence keeps older servers distinguishable from an explicit
false value.

v2LogLevel.description: LogLevel represents the severity level for log filtering.

token.description: token is the access token retained for protocol compatibility.

expiresAt.description: expires_at is the access-token expiry retained for protocol compatibility.

v2MQTTSourceConnectionConfig.description:
MQTTSourceConnectionConfig reports nonsecret MQTT source settings. The
password value is never returned through this API.

values.description: Legacy numeric values retained for mixed-version Frigate deployments.

v2ManufacturingSelfTestSummary.description:
ManufacturingSelfTestSummary keeps inventory polling bounded; complete
evidence is returned by GetManufacturingSelfTest.

v2MiningOperatingState.description:
MiningOperatingState identifies the device-level mining outcome. This is
intentionally separate from the per-hashboard MiningState state machine.

v2MiningState.description: MiningState represents the operational state of a hashboard.

v2Module.description: Module represents a module within a tank.

v2ModuleLayout.description: ModuleLayout describes the physical module grid inside a tank.

v2ModuleNumberingOrder.description: ModuleNumberingOrder describes how sequential module IDs fill a grid.

v2ModuleSelector.description: ModuleSelector selects a container module by tank and module number.

v2ModuleVoltageSetting.description:
ModuleVoltageSetting is one durable module voltage setting. An absent
fixed_millivolts field means firmware automatic voltage tuning.

macAddress.description:
mac_address is observation-only and absent when the interface identity
cannot be reported. SetNetworkConfig ignores this field and returns the
independently observed value in its response when available.

v2NetworkMode.description: NetworkMode represents the network interface configuration mode.

v2OSBuildInfo.description: OSBuildInfo contains immutable operating-system image identity.

v2OSBuildVariant.description: OSBuildVariant identifies the operating-system image variant.

v2PLLAlgorithm.description: PLLAlgorithm selects firmware PLL tuning used with a power-target point.

v2PerformanceMode.description:
PerformanceMode selects whether the miner prioritizes maximum hashrate or
efficiency within its power target. It is distinct from TuningAlgorithm.

v2PerformanceSweep.description: PerformanceSweep configures optional target-power sweep steps.

v2PerformanceSweepStep.description: PerformanceSweepStep is one target-power step in a sweep.

v2PhaseAggregate.description: PhaseAggregate contains aggregate power draw for a single electrical phase.

v2PlantAlarm.description: PlantAlarm identifies one currently active backend alarm.

v2PlantCoolingFanDirection.description: PlantCoolingFan contains one cooling fan's latest readings.

errorCode.description:
Deprecated: error_code was introduced before the V0821 value was
identified as a bitmap. New producers mirror error_bitmap here during the
rolling transition so older generated clients remain source/JSON/wire
compatible. New consumers accept this field only as a bitmap fallback.

errorBitmap.description:
Absence means the V0821 error-bitmap telemetry is unavailable. A present
zero means the controller supports it and currently reports no error bits.

v2PlantFault.description:
PlantFault contains one component's current numeric fault code and optional
V0821 error bitmap. The legacy code field remains the fault code so older
consumers keep one unique record per component and safely ignore the
additive bitmap.

buzzerActive.description:
BuzzerActive is the controller's direct audible-alarm output readback.
It is absent when the selected PLC transport does not expose that state.

v2PlantHealth.description: PlantHealth contains normalized optional container-plant telemetry.

v2PlantOperatingParameter.description: PlantOperatingParameter is one read-only raw PLC operating threshold.

v2PlantPowerDistribution.description: PlantPowerDistribution contains one distribution unit's latest readings.

v2PlantState.description: PlantState represents a backend-reported container-plant operating state.

shareWeight.description:
share_weight enables weighted mining for this pool. It is a relative,
positive weight; when absent the pool remains a priority failover target.

v2Pool.description:
Pool represents a mining pool configuration.
The password field is write-only and never included in responses.

v2PoolConnState.description:
PoolConnState mirrors the runtime connection state tracked by pkg/pools.

 - POOL_CONN_STATE_IDLE: POOL_CONN_STATE_IDLE indicates the pool is available but not actively mining.
 - POOL_CONN_STATE_ACTIVE: POOL_CONN_STATE_ACTIVE indicates the pool is a current mining target.
 - POOL_CONN_STATE_DEAD: POOL_CONN_STATE_DEAD indicates the pool is unreachable.

secondsSinceLastNotify.description: seconds_since_last_notify is -1 when a notify was never received.

configuredShareWeight.description: configured_share_weight is zero when this pool is not weighted.

effectiveShare.description:
effective_share is this pool's normalized target work fraction once the
current session is ready. A ready failover-only pool reports 1 when every
weighted pool is unavailable. It is zero when inactive or not yet ready.

isReady.description: is_ready is true after this connection session has delivered usable work.

sessionId.description: session_id changes on every successful connection activation.

v2PoolConnectionDiagnostics.description: PoolConnectionDiagnostics contains runtime connection diagnostics for one pool.

v2PowerFeed.description: PowerFeed contains one container power feed and optional telemetry.

v2PowerFeedState.description: PowerFeedState represents the state of a container power feed.

slot.description: slot is one-based when reported by the platform.

bootloaderVersion.description:
bootloader_version is absent when the PSU cannot report it independently
of its application firmware version.

v2PowerSupply.description: PowerSupply represents an installed power supply unit.

v2PowerSupplyFirmwareUpdateState.description: PowerSupplyFirmwareUpdateState identifies one PSU update lifecycle.

v2PowerSupplyFirmwareUpdateStatus.description:
PowerSupplyFirmwareUpdateStatus contains update metadata rather than live
electrical telemetry.

v2PowerSupplyStatus.description: PowerSupplyStatus represents the operational state of a PSU.

slot.description: slot is one-based when reported by the platform.

bootloaderVersion.description:
bootloader_version is absent when the PSU cannot report it independently
of its application firmware version.

v2PowerSupplySummary.description:
PowerSupplySummary contains PSU inventory identity without duplicating live
electrical telemetry.

v2PowerTargetRange.description: PowerTargetRange defines requested board power-target sweep points in watts.

v2PsuElectricalHealth.description: PsuElectricalHealth contains one complete power-supply electrical snapshot.

serial.description: serial is the PSU manufacturer serial, not the hashboard PCBA serial.

v2PsuIdentity.description:
PsuIdentity is stable manufacturer metadata for the shared power supply
identified by Hashboard.module_id. It is absent until compatible firmware
has reported and Frigate has durably retained the details.

v2PsuThermalHealth.description: PsuThermalHealth contains the power supply's thermal telemetry.

v2ReadOnlyDatabaseColumn.description: ReadOnlyDatabaseColumn describes one column in an allowlisted relation.

v2ReadOnlySQLCell.description:
ReadOnlySQLCell preserves PostgreSQL text encoding without losing numeric
precision and represents SQL NULL explicitly.

slot.description: slot is the one-based physical position associated with this record.

firmwareBuildId.description:
firmware_build_id is the recorded immutable firmware build identity when
the device reports one independently of the display version.

v2RecordedHashboardInventory.description:
RecordedHashboardInventory contains the device's latest recorded static
metadata for one hashboard. It is display-only evidence: it does not prove
that the hashboard is currently present in the recorded slot and must never
authorize a board-scoped read or mutation. Current serial identity is
deliberately absent.

token.description: token is the refresh token being exchanged.
token is the new access token retained for protocol compatibility.

expiresAt.description: expires_at is the access-token expiry retained for protocol compatibility.

refreshToken.description: refresh_token is populated when the server rotates the refresh token.

v2RunInArtifactDetail.description: RunInArtifactDetail controls the telemetry detail persisted in a result artifact.

v2RunInBoardStatus.description: RunInBoardStatus is a module member's independent run-in state.

v2RunInSourceCoverage.description: RunInSourceCoverage reports one HA owner's read capability and reachability.

v2RunInTaskBoard.description: RunInTaskBoard is one board's participation state in a module run-in.

v2SetContainerControlResponse.description: SetContainerControlResponse echoes the control state that was written.

v2SetContainerSetpointResponse.description: SetContainerSetpointResponse echoes the setpoint that was applied.

millivolts.description: millivolts must be between 26,000 and 30,000 inclusive.

expiresAt.description: expires_at is set for BLINK requests and omitted for OFF requests.

reason.description:
reason is an operator note (e.g. who has claimed the unit and why). It is
stored in the shared isolation ledger and returned by ListIsolation.

closed.description: closed=true requests CLOSE; false requests OPEN.
closed is the authoritative controller readback after the request.

changed.description: changed is false when the controller was already at the target state.

watts.description: watts is the manual per-board power target.

pllAlgorithm.description:
pll_algorithm selects the firmware PLL tuning algorithm used with watts.
Unspecified preserves the historical behavior and selects NONE.

watts.description: watts is the applied target after validation and clamping.

mode.description: mode selects one explicit canonical algorithm. Unspecified is invalid.
mode is the authoritative canonical algorithm after application.

v2Severity.description: Severity represents the severity level of an alert.

acceptedHashrateThs.description:
accepted_hashrate_ths is the hashrate derived from accepted
share difficulty over the response window, in terahashes per second.

serial.description:
serial is the stable R2 board identity for by_board entries. It is empty
for CT1, pool, and total groupings.

slot.description: slot is present only when all samples belong to one known R2 slot.

v2ShareQualityStats.description:
ShareQualityStats contains share acceptance metrics for a single grouping.
key is the CT1 MAC address for by_board entries, the pool name for by_pool
entries, and empty for the total aggregate. R2 by_board entries use serial.

v2ShareQualityWindow.description: ShareQualityWindow selects the rolling window for share quality statistics.

v2ShareRejectReason.description: ShareRejectReason counts share rejections grouped by pool-reported reason.

v2Slot.description: Slot represents a hashboard slot within a module.

v2SoftFeedMappingBoardResult.description: SoftFeedMappingBoardResult contains the soft mapping result for one board.

v2SoftFeedMappingBoardStatus.description: SoftFeedMappingBoardStatus is the per-board result of a soft mapping run.

v2SoftFeedMappingEvidence.description: SoftFeedMappingEvidence records the power-feed signal used for one board inference.

v2SoftFeedMappingRun.description: SoftFeedMappingRun is a snapshot of a soft feed mapping run.

boardIds.description: Optional board MAC addresses or serial numbers to test. Empty means all live mining boards.

feedIds.description: Optional feed IDs to consider as candidates. Empty means all configured/live feeds.

sampleCount.description: Number of power-feed samples to average for each measurement window.

perturbSettle.description: Delay after stopping the board before measuring the power drop.

restoreSettle.description: Delay after restarting the board before measuring recovery.

minDropWatts.description: Minimum power-feed watt drop needed to infer a mapping.

ambiguityRatio.description: If second-best drop / best drop exceeds this value, mark the result ambiguous.

localOnly.description:
Restrict the run to boards controlled by this node and skip HA-peer
delegation. Set automatically on delegated runs from the peer's parent
run; the server accepts such a run on a non-primary node only when the
call's source address is the configured HA peer. Any other local_only
start (like every other start) still requires this node to be the
container-write primary; apply always does.

v2SoftwareComponentVersion.description: SoftwareComponentVersion identifies one product software component.

v2SoftwareUpdateState.description: SoftwareUpdateState identifies the product software update lifecycle.

v2SoftwareUpdateStatus.description: SoftwareUpdateStatus contains current and available product image status.

scope.description:
scope is retained for CT1 compatibility. CT1 must provide scope and leave
r2_targets empty.

taskId.description:
task_id is optional and used by HA peers so sibling jobs from one cluster
deployment share a visible update identifier. Ordinary clients leave it empty.

r2Targets.description:
r2_targets selects R2 boards by stable serial number. R2 must provide at
least one selector and leave scope unset. Exactly one of scope or
r2_targets is valid. Empty, mixed, duplicate, incomplete, or stale
selection must fail explicitly.

localOnly.description: local_only is reserved for trusted HA peer delegation.

macAddress.description:
mac_address is the legacy CT1 board identity. It is empty for R2 and must
never contain a synthesized address.

layout.description: layout is present on the first frame and whenever the physical topology changes.

serial.description: serial is the stable R2 board identity.

slot.description: slot is the optional one-based R2 chassis slot.

v2StreamASICHealthResponse.description: StreamASICHealthResponse contains per-ASIC health data for a hashboard.

v2StreamContainerHealthResponse.description: StreamContainerHealthResponse contains plant and power-feed telemetry.

macAddress.description:
mac_address is the legacy CT1 board identity. It is empty for R2 and must
never contain a synthesized address.

serial.description: serial is the stable R2 board identity.

slot.description: slot is the optional one-based R2 chassis slot.

v2StreamHashboardHealthResponse.description: StreamHashboardHealthResponse contains a health snapshot for a single hashboard.

ipAddresses.description: IpAddresses contains active non-loopback host addresses.

resources.description:
Resources is an optional point-in-time host and process sample. Older
implementations omit it while preserving the static identity fields.

hostDiskUsedBytes.description: Host disk values describe the root filesystem visible to Frigate.

v2SystemResources.description: SystemResources contains one point-in-time host and Frigate process sample.

moduleLayout.description:
module_layout describes the physical module grid for this tank. Only
mapped modules appear in modules; grid gaps remain meaningful positions.

v2Tank.description: Tank represents a physical tank in the container.

v2TemperatureSeriesSelector.description:
TemperatureSeriesSelector identifies one retained board or PSU sensor.
Board indexes are the zero-based indexes advertised by firmware.

v2TimeRange.description: TimeRange specifies a time window for queries.

v2TimeSeriesBucket.description: TimeSeriesBucket contains aggregated metrics for a time window.

v2TimeSeriesMetric.description:
TimeSeriesMetric identifies the metric type for time series queries.

 - TIME_SERIES_METRIC_PLANT_INLET_TEMPERATURE: Plant metrics are container-scoped and ignore the identifier field.
 - TIME_SERIES_METRIC_PLANT_PHASE_POWER: Component metrics require identifier to select a phase, distribution
unit, fan, or power feed.
 - TIME_SERIES_METRIC_TEMPERATURE_SENSOR: Sensor-specific board or PSU temperature history. Requests must include a
TemperatureSeriesSelector; the legacy TEMPERATURE metric remains the
aggregate across every board sensor.

v2TuningAlgorithm.description:
TuningAlgorithm names the canonical mining tuning algorithm shared by all
products. Implementations map these semantic values to their native tuning
engine without exposing product-specific enum fields on the MDK API.

v2TuningSweep.description: TuningSweep configures fixed-voltage points crossed with either fixed-frequency or power-target/PLL-algorithm points.

v2TuningSweepFailurePolicy.description: TuningSweepFailurePolicy controls sweep behavior when applying a point fails.

v2UnitTag.description:
UnitTag is an operator note for a tagged unit. kind is "module" (key = module
ID), "board" (key = MAC address), or "power_feed" (key = container power-feed
ID, e.g. pdu-1-outlet-03).

v2UnlockStatus.description: UnlockStatus contains the device unlock state.

v2VoltageRange.description: VoltageRange defines requested PSU voltage sweep points in volts.
